headline: NTSC-U frontend routines land in Up Your Arsenal
summary: Contributors added native NTSC-U frontend routines for state updates, timers, fades and dialog handling through #1. The NTSC-U progress commit reports 5,677 of 16,222 functions and 8.38% matched code; the snapshot's separate headline progress remains at 5,807 of 16,164 functions and 8.72% code, so those figures describe different reports.
highlights: #1 describes six native routines in eight program placements, with NTSC validation. Matching means compiling to the original game's exact bytes.
